style_summary: Physical souvenir fridge magnet photography combining cloisonné metal wireframe techniques with translucent enamel-glass textures. The visual core compactly integrates a stylized character, a landmark background, and 2-3 specialty cultural symbols. The outer contour is heavily defined by a thick metal die-cut edge that perfectly traces the skyline of the architectural silhouette. The color language utilizes high-saturation, glass-reflective jewel tones physically separated by raised, reflective brass/gold lines, presenting a highly tactile, premium collectible product.

environment_variables.LOCATION_NAME: City or location name. Must be short (1-2 words), e.g., 'TOKYO' or 'PARIS'. This text will be physically cast onto a raised metal ribbon/banner at the bottom of the design.
environment_variables.LANDMARK_BUILDING: The core landmark. Description must include top-edge architectural features, e.g., 'a classical pagoda with multiple tiered eaves'. The AI will use this to generate the irregular top die-cut metal silhouette.
environment_variables.SPECIALTY_ITEMS: 2 to 3 local specialties or cultural symbols. Must be concrete physical objects, e.g., 'a pretzel and a beer stein'. These serve as foreground embellishments clustered tightly around the character.
environment_variables.CHARACTER_SUBJECT: Core character subject (described via text or image prompt). Specify outfit, features, and pose. Note: Whether using text or an image prompt, the character must be forcefully stylized into the 'flat color block + metal wire' enamel pin aesthetic. Photorealistic facial features are strictly prohibited.

zones.typography_zone: Bottom center, typically an extruded metal banner or ribbon holding raised 3D metal lettering.
zones.focal_zone: Occupies 70% of the canvas. Foreground: character; Midground: specialty items; Background: landmark building. All tightly overlapping.
zones.negative_space: Zero negative space. All areas must be physically filled with metal framework or poured enamel pools. No empty atmospheric voids.

composition.depth_logic: Bas-relief physical layering. Depth is derived exclusively from the physical thickness of the metal borders, the raised wireframes, and the convex meniscus of the glossy enamel. Atmospheric perspective is strictly prohibited.
composition.scale_contrast: Exaggerated souvenir proportions. Specialty items and characters are upscaled, while massive landmark buildings are miniaturized to fit the badge mold.
composition.edge_treatment: Custom thick die-cut metal border. The top outer edge must precisely trace and hug the architectural silhouette of the background landmark.
permissions: Authorized to aggressively simplify architectural details into geometric shapes enclosed by metal lines
Authorized to flatten character faces and clothing folds into unshaded pure color blocks
Authorized to shatter realistic scale proportions to fit a flat badge mold

typography.letterform_character: Bold, industrial, possessing physical thickness and metallic weight

hierarchy.style: Heavy vintage sans-serif or slab serif, large scale
hierarchy.treatment: 3D extruded metal cast, same material as the outer border, no printed ink

typography.readability_rule: Highly legible, allowing for slight bright specular metallic reflections on the letter edges
text_constraints: Strictly no handwritten brush strokes or flat printed ink textures

color_palette.Polished_Brass_Gold: #D4AF37 — Highly reflective polished brass used for all dividing wires, borders, and text
color_palette.Ruby_Glaze: #9B111E — Translucent liquid-like ruby red enamel glass
color_palette.Sapphire_Enamel: #0F52BA — Deep, highly saturated sapphire blue resin
color_palette.Pearl_White: #F0EAD6 — Milky white poured resin with a subtle sheen

color_constraints.dominant: Polished Brass Gold acts as the skeletal framework (approx. 20% visual area), with the rest filled by high-saturation jewel tones
color_constraints.accent_roles: Character apparel or core specialty items must utilize Ruby Glaze or Sapphire Enamel to draw focal attention
color_constraints.special_rules: Every single boundary between two different colors MUST be physically separated by a Polished Brass Gold wire
forbidden: Strictly no color gradients within shapes (color blocks must be pure)
Strictly no dull, muddy, or low-saturation earth tones
Strictly no neon or glowing emissive colors

visual_direction.lighting: Studio ring light product photography. Angled frontal lighting creating sharp, bright specular highlights on both the metallic wire edges and the convex glossy enamel surfaces.
visual_direction.mood: Premium, highly tactile, collectible physical souvenir (is a tangible manufactured object, is not a digital illustration)
visual_direction.material_textures: Raised rigid polished metal combined with smooth, convex, liquid-tension glass/enamel pools
visual_direction.print_finish: Macro studio photography of a die-cast metal and injected-resin physical product

metal_cloisonne_wires.physical: Uniform thickness, 3D raised metallic lines with specular highlights
metal_cloisonne_wires.placement: Webbed throughout the entire design, outlining every single internal and external shape
allowed: Forming tightly closed loops to hold liquid enamel
forbidden: Strictly no broken lines, no extreme variation in wire thickness, no sketchy/pencil qualities

specialty_icons.physical: Highly abstracted flat shapes enclosed in thick metal wire
specialty_icons.placement: Flanking the central character or resting on the bottom corners of the badge
allowed: Physically overlapping with the character or the outer border
forbidden: Strictly no painted volumetric shading, no 3D rendering

do: Maintain the overwhelming optical illusion that this is a heavy, physical object sitting on a table or stuck to a fridge
Place against a neutral studio backdrop (pure white or light grey) with a solid, physical drop shadow cast by the magnet
avoid: Avoid generating flat watercolors, vector illustrations, or 2.5D digital paintings
If an image prompt is used, strictly avoid pasting a photorealistic face into the artwork; the AI tends to do this, so it must undergo extreme stylistic degradation into flat enamel blocks
Avoid atmospheric perspective (fading backgrounds); the AI tends to add depth, but everything here exists firmly within the same 5mm physical thickness
